After finishing training
with Rice Shower—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh, aren't you going home, Onii-sama...?
choice_data_list: I need to prepare for tomorrow's training

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh, aren't you going home, Onee-sama...?
choice_data_list: I need to prepare for tomorrow's training

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Big Brother...
Are you still working for Rice's sake...?
choice_data_list: Rice, go home and get some rest

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Big Sister...
Are you still working for Rice's sake...?
choice_data_list: Rice, go home and get some rest

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, okay. See you later, Big Brother..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, okay. See you later, Big Sister..."

"After finishing preparations for tomorrow's training,
I spotted Rice Shower running on the track on my way home."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Not yet, Rice still...
has to do her best...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Dear brother.
You found me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Dear sister.
You found me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Since you're working so hard for Rice, Big Brother,
Rice wanted to work hard too...
choice_data_list: I'll join you for a bit of training.
Just the thought alone makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If Big Sister is working hard for Rice's sake,
then Rice wants to work hard too...
choice_data_list: I'll join you for a bit of training.
Just the thought alone makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Thank you, big brother...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Thank you, big sister...!

Afterward, I oversaw Rice Shower's
extra training session.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm…… But Rice wants to be helpful
to Big Brother, too……"
choice_data_list: Going home all by myself is pretty lonely...

Alright, Rice is going to go change.
Please wait a little bit...!
Afterward, Rice Shower changed her clothes, and we headed home together.
